newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: F&P to launch new dishwasher in 1998.
newsitem.headline: F&P to launch new dishwasher in 1998.

text.p: Domestic appliance manufacturer Fisher and Paykel Ltd said on Friday it would start limited production of a new style of dishwasher in July/August for launch in 1998.
F&P General Manager of Corporate Affairs Richard Blundell told Reuters the appliance industry viewed the machine at the Domotechnica Trade Fair in Germany from February 18 to 21.
"Anecdotal evidence would say that it was well-received," Blundell said, adding the fair was seen as the benchmark for the industry.
The machine, yet to be named, is the same size and shape of a conventional washer except it has two totally independent drawers.

"The feedback we are getting is that owners will adapt it to their own use," Blundell said. For example, a family might use the top draw for glasses and the bottom one for plates. The top might be used several times a day while the bottom perhaps just once every two days.
Blundell said the machine was effectively two machines in one. The "dishdraw" uses similar technology to the "Smart Drive" employed in F&P's washing machines.
"All we are saying publicly is that it uses similar motors to Smart Drive. It's taking that technology one step further," Blundell said.
From July, production would ramp up towards the end of the year. It will go through an extended test market for most of this year before a full launch some time in early 1998.
Blundell stressed it was early days. "We haven't made one yet, we haven't sold one yet."
